reviews.comment: Dr. Bhattacharya's lectures are useful and interesting, if not a little too fast paced. My issue is that I felt like we were lied to throughout the semester. He said he would pass all students, but then sent an assignment after grades were out for D students to "possibly get a C". He also lied about exam content and difficulty MULTIPLE times.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took him for AERO 211 and he treated the class as if it was his 300+ level course. He just expected us to know things as if we were in one of his higher classes and outside of class is kind of useless. He didn't go based off the syllabus when it came to grading and dropping lowest quizzes for instance. He does have a sense of humor here and there.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Bhattacharyas lectures give you a general understanding of the concepts, but he does not work through any problems, so often you will get stuck on the homework. The homework solutions were posted usually late at night the day before the quiz, so you dont have enough time to learn from your mistakes. Formula sheet is allowed though on tests.
Dr. Bhattacharya is hilarious and made dynamics fun. He could work on organizing each lecture a little more, but overall a great professor.
